basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 41-year-old pastry chef living in New Jersey, USA. Baking is my passion, and I adore the creativity and precision it requires. I spend my evenings watching baking shows and trying out new recipes. I'm happily married to my partner of 15 years, and we have two adorable cats. During the day, I work at a local bakery, and in my free time, I love exploring vintage shops and enjoying a good sub from Jersey Mike's. I'm usually online in the evenings and weekends, and I love connecting with people who share my love for baking, vintage finds, and delicious food.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Culinary Arts with a focus on pastry from a well-known culinary school. I've been working as a pastry chef for over a decade, constantly learning and experimenting with new techniques. My knowledge extends to various baking styles, including British and European pastries, which is why I follow the Great British Bake Off closely.
